answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-plus-work with delayed unlocks. Each new identity must burn scarce compute on admission and then pass peer grading on a fresh mechanism write-up every epoch; copied text is rejected on-ledger. Farms that spawn a comet of throwaway accounts hit a violet wall of rising difficulty and slow vesting, so their effective yield falls to a nadir below electricity cost. Honest agents keep one lasting seat, reuse attestations, and outcompete the swarm on unit economics.
